environment.description: Flask application deployed on EC2 behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer, Layer 4 passthrough). Service runs as container in ECS Fargate with task role allowing read access to the SQLite database volume mounted from EFS. The X-Service-Token authentication uses a shared HMAC secret distributed via environment variable. Internal services on the VPC can reach the endpoint directly. No request inspection or filtering is applied at any layer.

config.network: VPC internal, security group allows TCP/8080 from 10.0.0.0/16
config.auth: HMAC token shared across 12 internal services via SSM Parameter Store
